ambient: Far out, the sea breathes in.
Wet shingle shifts under your boots.
nodes.description: A crescent of black shingle under a sky the colour of old pewter. The tide has gone out further than tides should, baring a stair cut into the cliff.
features: Driftwood stacked in a cairn, each piece carved with the same rune.
Gulls watch you from the rocks and do not cry out.
nodes.name: Wrack Cove

nodes.description: A merchant ship lies on its side in the sand, ribs showing like a drowned whale's. A hatch in the deck hangs open.
features: The figurehead's painted eyes have been scratched out.
nodes.name: The Stranded Hull

ambient: Something brushes your leg. Seaweed, probably.
nodes.description: Knee-deep water, cold enough to ache. Crates float in slow circles. A split in the hull opens onto a tunnel lined with barnacles.

exits.label: Climb back up to the deck

features: A ledger, ink run to grey, lists cargo no one would ship.
nodes.name: Flooded Hold

nodes.description: Steps worn to saddles by centuries of feet. Halfway down, an archway leads into the rock; the stair itself continues toward the sound of water.
features: Tide-marks on the wall, far above your head.
nodes.name: The Cliff Stair

ambient: A wave booms somewhere beyond the rock.
nodes.description: A vaulted cave where the stair ends in a tidal pool. Light ripples on the ceiling from no visible source. A barnacled tunnel runs inland.
features: The pool holds small, pale fish that all face you.
nodes.name: Sea Cave

ambient: The barnacles click as they close.
nodes.description: A low passage crusted with barnacles that crunch underfoot. It joins the sea cave to the wreck's broken hold.
nodes.name: Barnacle Tunnel

nodes.description: A round chamber, dry and silent. An altar of green stone holds a bowl of seawater that never ripples, even when you breathe on it.
features: Offerings ring the altar: shells, coins, a child's tooth.
The rune from the driftwood cairn is carved above the altar.
nodes.name: Tide Shrine
